Requirements Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of business analysis experience in the IT industry, with recent experience overseeing cross-functional teams. 6+ years of experience supporting Federal Government agencies or projects. FDA experience required Proven experience managing cross-functional teams. Experience with creating and communicating consistent standards and best practices for project management. Experience with effective engagement and communication with senior stakeholders and clients. Strong understanding of Agile development methodologies (SCRUM), including backlog management, sprint planning, and user story development. Proficiency in tools such as JIRA, Confluence, or other project management platforms. Knowledge of UI/UX workflows, including wireframes and process flows, is a plus. Experience with Commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) platforms such as Appian, Salesforce, or Pega. Familiarity with federal regulatory agencies, particularly the FDA, is a significant advantage. Attributes for Success Leadership Excellence: Ability to lead teams, promote collaboration, and foster a positive and productive work environment. Structured and Strategic Thinking: Skilled at implementing processes and practices to ensure high-quality, consistent deliverables across projects. Client-Focused Mindset: Strong ability to maintain and build relationships with clients and stakeholders, ensuring their needs are at the forefront of deliverables. Collaborative Approach: Adept at working cross-functionally with technical leads, Product Owners, and other stakeholders to ensure success. Proactive Self-Starter: Capable of independently identifying areas for improvement, addressing challenges, and driving continuous improvement. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future. Department Summary: MITRE’s Trustworthy & Secure AI (TSAI) Department consists of a diverse team united by a passion and a sense of urgency to harness trustworthy and assured artificial intelligence (AI) to help solve problems in the public interest. The TSAI Department supports our sponsors' missions by delivering capabilities for securing and increasing trust in AI-enabled systems, including data driven AI risk awareness and mitigation, AI red teaming, and trusted tools and techniques for applying AI in high consequence environments. The TSAI Department works across government, industry, and academia to provide, assess, and shape trustworthy and secure AI systems to address complex mission needs for our sponsors. Our work provides opportunities to address real-world challenges in the rapidly developing field of AI assurance, and to research and prototype new methods to address mission needs. We are looking for highly motivated, adaptive, and self-directed candidates to perform research, development, engineering, evaluation, and integration of secure AI systems. Specific responsibilities will include: Perform AI adversarial threat analysis to identify and characterize vulnerabilities in real-world national security systems Work as a technical subject matter expert within a team of intelligence analysts to research, analyze and produce intelligence reports Assessing threats to AI-enabled systems and use of AI by adversaries Convey complex ideas to non-technical audiences through intelligence production, briefings and/or white papers Basic Qualifications: Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of experience in artificial intelligence with a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 3 years’ experience; or equivalent combination of AI-related education and work experience. Advanced understanding of foundational AI/ML theory, with demonstrated ability to reason about AI system behavior, vulnerabilities, and evaluation Hands-on experience with building and evaluating computer vision systems Excellent written and verbal communication skills to articulate challenging technical concepts to both lay and expert audiences Proven ability to lead interdisciplinary teams and engage senior mission stakeholders across technical and operational domains Must have an active Top Secret/SCI and must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Top Secret/SCI with CI Polygraph U.S Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance. This position has an on-site requirement of 5 days a week on-site Preferred Qualifications: Advanced degree in computer science, engineering, or related disciplines Hands-on experience deploying and using enterprise-grade AI systems, particularly generative, agentic, and/or multimodal AI systems Experience with one or more of the following AI security topics: AI red teaming, AI T&E, adversarial AI, AI-enhanced cybersecurity, AI strategy and governance Experience generating or analyzing intelligence reporting data Familiarity with MITRE ATLAS threat matrix Experience leading small to medium sized teams to solve practical technical challenges Active IC or DOD TS/SCI security clearance with CI Poly This requisition requires the candidate to have a minimum of the following clearance(s): Top Secret/SCI This requisition requires the hired candidate to have or obtain, within one year from the date of hire, the following clearance(s): Top Secret/SCI/Polygraph Salary compensation range and midpoint: $174,000 - $217,500 - $261,000 Annual Work Location Type: Onsite Commitment to Non-Discrimination All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local or international law.
